figures.label: S27
figures.caption: Supplementary Fig. 27 | Structural response of Cl1.5 to modeled LiCl removal and its relationship to the proposed chloride-redistribution pathway. Cl-deficient Cl1.5 structures viewed along the (a) [001] and (b) [−110] directions. The green and grey polyhedra represent the LixCl coordination environments at the 4a and 4d sites, respectively. Removal of a LiCl unit generates local Li/Cl vacancies, indicated by the red sphere, and is accompanied by distortion of the adjacent PS43⁻ tetrahedra shown in purple. This local structural response may modify the energetics of chloride redistribution along the proposed 4a → 4d → 4a pathway but does not independently establish the migration rate.
